subject: Application: Application Support Specialist – Malaichamy Sethuraman – Immediate Joiner
body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the *Application Support Specialist*
role at Cyrus Technology. With substantial experience across application
production support, database querying, and root-cause troubleshooting, I
bring strong hands-on problem-solving skills to help stabilize customer
workflows and maintain high service standards.

Following an organizational restructuring, my last working day was July 24,
2026. As an *immediate joiner* with zero notice period, I am available to
start right away. I am also fully flexible and prepared to support *24/7
rotational shifts, weekend coverage, and on-call schedules* whenever
required.

*Key Qualifications & Value Brought to Cyrus Technology:*

   -

   *Technical Troubleshooting & RCA:* Deep experience analyzing application
   behavior, reviewing error logs, reproducing bugs, and providing
   comprehensive documentation to engineering and development squads.
   -

   *SQL & Data Analysis:* Strong proficiency in writing relational SQL
   queries (filtering, aggregations, multi-table JOINs) to inspect database
   records, validate backend integrity, and troubleshoot data discrepancies.
   -

   *Data Validation & Reporting:* Highly skilled in data manipulation and
   validation using advanced Excel techniques (lookups, formulas, data
   filtering, and Pivot Tables) alongside ticketing and tracking workflows.
   -

   *Incident Management & Customer Focus:* Proven ability to translate
   complex technical issues into clear updates for non-technical users while
   managing ticket lifecycles strictly within SLA thresholds.

My resume is attached for your detailed review. I would welcome the
opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise and immediate
availability can support your application operations and customer success.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

-- 
Thanks,
Malaichamy

malai.hopes@gmail.com | malai.kpb@gmail.com
